issues: Covers were 3,588, up 273 (8.24%) week on week and 765 (27.10%) year on year.
Spend per head was £20.57, up £0.01 (0.05%) week on week and down £2.54 (10.99%) year on year, missing the £22 target with lots of £5 and free ramen vouchers used.
Sales were £73,803.83, up £5,634.26 (8.26%) week on week and £8,555.90 (13.11%) year on year, and £6,303.83 (9.34%) above the £67,500 target.
Total discounts for the week were £6,277.17, including £2,493.40 of staff meals.
Top sellers were Steak Tataki Ramen (442, plus 62 halal), Chicken Ramen (384) and Black Garlic Tonkotsu (307); scallop and octopus nigiri sold once and octopus sashimi twice.
The drinks target was hit but sushi and sides were not.
Cuts were made and more hours used than last week, but wage revenue was on target, with a labour split of 45.08% FOH and 54.92% BOH against a 45% and 55% target.
Food usage variance 3.8% and wet 1.5%, within the acceptable range.
Google reviews: twelve 5 star and four 4 star.
Weekly hygiene compliance 100%; pest control, fire, electrical, gas and ventilation up to date.
Rory's compliance app is still not working.
Maintenance: Kris installed the new water boiler, the kitchen sockets are fixed, and the glass wash no longer leaks after the engineer visit and nozzle cleaning.
Staffing: May and Tobi are still away, Bethan and Kai are away this weekend, and Louis is away Monday to Thursday in the week of 26 October.
A week long SPH incentive has been launched, and a cocktail special may run to test an updated drinks menu.
SPH and sides sales are the stated areas for improvement.
Upcoming: XOXO and the Maki App (ongoing) and the student frozen ramen activation.
